rule: One authority, many governed capabilities (UNIIMENTE_FINAL_BUILD_ORDER §3, §9, §13). Every lineage keeps an implementation id, its measured results verbatim from its own record, and a disposition. SUPERSEDED/RETAIN never means deleted. Dispositions create no authority; merging any lineage is a founder decision.

dispositions.PRODUCTIZE: carried into this branch as the canonical main-compatible implementation
dispositions.RECOMBINE: a mechanism ported into this branch with credit; the rest retained as a competing implementation
dispositions.RETAIN_AS_EVIDENCE: preserved unmerged with its results; placed relative to the #137 decision
dispositions.RETAIN_AS_EVIDENCE+MECHANISM_SOURCE: as above, and named mechanisms are queued for porting once its base lands
dispositions.ADJACENT_MAIN_COMPATIBLE: main-based work that touches neighbouring files; not a cognition seed
